SELECT g.id, g.company_id, g.distributor_id, g.config_service_local_id, g.geofence_id, g.geofence_data, g.status, g.created, g.updated, s.service_id AS service_id, c.app_key AS app_key, c.type AS config_type FROM distribution_distributor_geofence g INNER JOIN map_config_service s ON s.company_id = g.company_id AND s.id = g.config_service_local_id INNER JOIN map_config c ON c.company_id = s.company_id AND c.id = s.config_id WHERE g.company_id = #{companyId} AND g.distributor_id = #{distributorId}
AND g.id = #{geofenceId}
